# mungbeans.io

> Independent, ad-free equity research and weekly stock screening around the 200-week moving average, FCF-yield dislocations (Bean Score), micro-cap innovation, and forensic single-stock deep dives. Updated every Saturday after Friday market close.

## Core Research Sections

- [Homepage](https://mungbeans.io/): Weekly summary of ~2,000 tracked stocks against their 200-week moving average, latest deep dives, and actionable value zones.
- [All Stocks Screener](https://mungbeans.io/stocks/): Full interactive screener covering ~2,000 US equities with 200WMA distance, 14-week RSI, historical touch returns, Bean Score, insider buying, share buybacks, and Dislocation Stack.
- [Stock Screens Index](https://mungbeans.io/screens/): Pre-built, static, weekly-updated stock lists filtered by quality, cash flow, insider buying, valuation dislocation, and momentum.
- [AI Exposure Screener](https://mungbeans.io/ai-exposure/): Two-axis map separating AI Capex Bust Exposure (depreciation overhang, negative FCF / capex funding gap, circular financing & vendor equity ties, AI revenue concentration, market-implied AI beta) from AI Toll Collectors (proprietary data moats with low bust risk).
- [AI Exposure Methodology](https://mungbeans.io/methodology/ai-exposure/): Full v0.2 scoring specification covering the 2-axis quadrant matrix, five bust pillars, four toll-gate pillars, relevance gate, and filing-backed curation rules.
- [Deep Dives](https://mungbeans.io/deep-dives/): Five-tab forensic single-stock theses (Thesis, Verdict, Overhangs, Numbers, Bear Case) with immutable publish prices and live performance tracking.
- [Weekly Signal Reports](https://mungbeans.io/blog/): Saturday summaries of every stock that newly crossed below or recovered above its 200-week moving average.
- [Micro Cap Innovation Screener](https://mungbeans.io/microcaps/): Sub-$500M innovation screen scoring cash runway, R&D intensity, patent activity, and revenue inflection.
- [The Book](https://mungbeans.io/book/): Live real-money portfolio and dated call ledger tracked transparently against SPY.
- [Tools I Pay For](https://mungbeans.io/tools/): Complete list of referral links on mungbeans.io with disclosures and honest limits. The site carries no display advertising.

## Live Stock Screens (Updated Weekly)

- [Large-Cap Stocks Below 200WMA](https://mungbeans.io/screens/large-cap-below-200wma/): Companies with $10B+ market cap trading below their 200-week moving average.
- [Buffett Quality Below 200WMA](https://mungbeans.io/screens/buffett-quality-below-200wma/): ROE > 15%, debt-to-equity < 50%, positive free cash flow, profitable, and below the 200-week line.
- [Dividend Aristocrats Below 200WMA](https://mungbeans.io/screens/dividend-aristocrats-below-200wma/): 25+ year dividend growers currently below their 200-week moving average.
- [Conviction Insider Buying Below 200WMA](https://mungbeans.io/screens/insider-buying-below-200wma/): Stocks below the 200-week line with $500K+ open-market SEC Form 4 insider purchases in the last 12 months.
- [Growing Free Cash Flow Below 200WMA](https://mungbeans.io/screens/growing-fcf-below-200wma/): Companies expanding free cash flow while trading below their 200-week moving average.
- [Wide-Moat Stocks Below 200WMA](https://mungbeans.io/screens/wide-moat-below-200wma/): Gross margin > 40% and ROE > 15% while below the 200-week moving average.
- [Share Cannibals Below 200WMA](https://mungbeans.io/screens/share-cannibals-below-200wma/): Companies that reduced shares outstanding by 5%+ over 3 years while trading below the 200-week line.
- [Oversold Stocks Below 200WMA (RSI < 30)](https://mungbeans.io/screens/oversold-below-200wma/): Stocks below their 200-week moving average with 14-week RSI below 30.
- [Small-Cap Value Multibaggers Below 200WMA](https://mungbeans.io/screens/yartseva-multibaggers-below-200wma/): Sub-$2B companies with positive equity, FCF yield >= 5%, and book-to-market >= 0.4 below the 200-week line.
- [Approaching 200WMA (Within 5%)](https://mungbeans.io/screens/approaching-200wma/): Watchlist of stocks sitting 0% to 5% above their 200-week moving average.
- [Bean Score Deep Value (+2σ FCF Dislocation)](https://mungbeans.io/screens/bean-score-deep-value/): Stocks whose trailing FCF yield sits at least two standard deviations cheaper than their own quarterly baseline.
- [Stacked Dislocations & WOW (6EQUJ5) Signals](https://mungbeans.io/screens/stacked-dislocations/): Multi-factor convergence screen combining price drawdown, FCF yield, dividend yield, sector-relative dislocation, buyback acceleration, and insider intensity.
- [AI Toll Collectors (Proprietary Data Moats)](https://mungbeans.io/screens/ai-toll-collectors/): Curated companies owning authoritative, legally mandated, or exclusive real-time data toll gates with low AI capex bust exposure.
- [AI Capex Bust Exposure (AI Bag Holders)](https://mungbeans.io/screens/ai-bag-holders/): Stocks most vulnerable to an AI capex slowdown due to negative FCF funding gaps, high AI revenue dependence, circular financing, and high market-implied AI beta.
- [AI Depreciation Overhang & Capex Intensity](https://mungbeans.io/screens/ai-depreciation-bombs/): AI infrastructure, hyperscaler, and power buildout stocks ranked by capex-to-D&A gap, useful-life extensions, and capital-funding pressure.

## URL Conventions

- Individual stock signal page: `https://mungbeans.io/stocks/<ticker-lowercase>/` (example: `https://mungbeans.io/stocks/nvda/`) — includes AI Exposure diagnostics and FAQ for AI-linked tickers.
- Forensic deep dive: `https://mungbeans.io/deep-dives/<ticker-lowercase>/` (examples: `https://mungbeans.io/deep-dives/hims/`, `https://mungbeans.io/deep-dives/geni/`)

## Methodology & Editorial Policy

- **200-Week Moving Average (200WMA):** Roughly four years of weekly adjusted closes. Episodes below the line use 2-week recovery hysteresis to measure historical touch depth, duration, and subsequent 12-month and 24-month returns vs SPY.
- **Bean Score:** Stock-specific z-score measuring how far current trailing-twelve-month FCF yield deviates from the stock's own quarterly baseline, normalized by its own historical intra-quarter standard deviation. Positive = unusually cheap; negative = unusually expensive.
- **Dislocation Stack & WOW (`6EQUJ5`):** Counts independent cheapness signals per stock (0–6) with an earnings-quality accrual-gap gate to flag value traps. A WOW signal fires only when all four convergence tiers (price absurdity, business health, smart money, and historical bounce record) align simultaneously.
- **AI Exposure Matrix (v0.2):** Scores AI-linked stocks on two orthogonal axes — AI Bust Exposure (0–100) and AI Toll Gate (0–100, curated-only) — separating Toll Collectors, Levered Landlords, Bystanders, and AI Bag Holders with filing-linked sources.
- **Accountability:** All content is educational research, not investment advice. Every deep dive carries its publish date and closing price permanently; errors receive dated inline correction notes rather than silent edits.
